prompt: How old was the first minister of the Ministry of Digital Affairs in Poland when Andrzej Halicki became minister?
answer: Anna Streżyńska, the first Minister of Digital Affairs in Poland, was **47 years old** when Andrzej Halicki became Minister of Administration and Digitization on September 22, 2014. She was born on May 11, 1967.
